name: revdiff-coherent-immutable-review-snapshots
instr:
revdiff cannot keep a review tied to one source state while that source changes. Add immutable snapshots with atomic explicit refresh; failed refreshes must leave the current review usable.

Renderers from `diff.NewGit`, `diff.NewHg`, `diff.NewJj`, `diff.NewCompareReader`, `diff.NewDirectoryReader`, and `diff.NewStdinReader` must return one stable identity, file list, and matching diffs until idempotent closure. After closure, reads fail wholly with `ErrSnapshotClosed`. Git must cover working-tree, index, staged, rename, untracked, revision, and literal-pathspec changes. Hg must freeze translated double-dot and triple-dot revisions and keep ignoring staged mode. Jj must bind one operation while preserving fileset quoting, rename expansion, synthesized binary diffs, and no staging. Compare and directory snapshots freeze file content. Stdin keeps immutable in-memory and nonmatching-path behavior without filesystem cleanup.

`diff.NewIncludeFilter`, `diff.NewExcludeFilter`, and `diff.NewFallbackRenderer` must preserve the underlying identity and lifecycle while applying their existing views. Accepted asynchronous file, diff, and fingerprint results must share the active identity. Refresh must validate a complete newest candidate before publishing it, close rejected or superseded candidates, and prevent older completions replacing newer accepted snapshots. Navigation keeps captured content until refresh succeeds.

Every invocation must acquire one initial snapshot. On normal exit
